title: Noxious Fumes
description: At the start of your turn, apply 2 [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
upgraded_description: At the start of your turn, apply 3 [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
notes: This power triggers at the start of each turn, applying poison to all enemies. The poison amount increases from 2 to 3 when upgraded.
